game.q: parvati gives the boy his very first job. what is it?
opts: guard her door, let no one in

wrong.snacks: sweet, but no. this job is serious.
wrong.dishes: every parent’s dream job. not this one.

game.right: YES. guard the door. and he took that job very, very seriously.

end.line: a broken day gave him a new face, and that face is honored first, before every beginning.

cliff.s1: it was meant to be the best day of his life.

share: turmeric paste. one breath. a brand-new boy. how ganesha got his head, on infinite hill
